cim: How to claim your business in ChatGPT with Shopify
cim_eredeti: How to claim your business in ChatGPT with Shopify
szoveg_eredeti:
Claim your business in ChatGPT by connecting your Shopify store. This demo shows how to start in Business Hub or the Shopify App Store, then connect your store directly to ChatGPT. After that, you can manage your business information to shape how you show up in ChatGPT.

Claim your business in Business Hub
https://chatgpt.com/business-hub

Connect through the Shopify App Store
https://apps.shopify.com/chatgpt

prioritas.indok: Gyakorlati e-kereskedelmi integracio az OpenAI es a Shopify kozott, ami sok vallalkozast erint. Forrás-tapasztalat: -4.
prioritas.cim_hu: Igy kapcsolhatjak ossze a kereskedok a Shopify-uzletuket a ChatGPT-vel
prioritas.lead_hu: Az OpenAI lehetoove tette a kereskedok szamara, hogy a Shopify integraciojan keresztul igazoljak es kezeljek vallalkozasuk adatait a ChatGPT-ben.
